mapper.sql: select upload_id, token_hash, owner_user_id, file_name, file_size, content_type, file_ext, staging_location, state, link_id, expire_at, create_time, update_time from share_upload
mapper.insert: insert into share_upload ( token_hash, owner_user_id, file_name, file_size, content_type, file_ext, staging_location, state, expire_at, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{tokenHash}, #{ownerUserId}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{fileExt}, #{stagingLocation}, #{state}, #{expireAt}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update share_upload set state = 'BOUND', update_time = sysdate() where upload_id = #{uploadId}
update share_upload set state = 'EXPIRED', update_time = sysdate() where upload_id = #{uploadId}
